# affectUI licensed vendor provenance

Adapted for approved DATUMM M1 on 13 November 2026. Public raw source retrieved 12 November 2026; local raw SHA-256 values reverified before copying.

Upstream: [flohoeller/affectui at 7d0f0984b856d56c362c7bc5ed67b023e776aa2f](https://github.com/flohoeller/affectui/tree/7d0f0984b856d56c362c7bc5ed67b023e776aa2f/components). License: [MIT](https://github.com/flohoeller/affectui/blob/7d0f0984b856d56c362c7bc5ed67b023e776aa2f/LICENSE), copyright 2026 Florian Höller (adfects). The byte-identical license is retained in LICENSE.txt. Supplied Hugeicons attribution/comments remain with the source; no Hugeicons package is imported.

Exactly 22 pinned TSX sources are adopted. NumberInput and ProgressTracker are intentionally not copied; native numeric drafts and authoritative readonly checklist owners remain. No Pro source, additional helper module, package, font request, service, environment or native-operation change is introduced. Original component/export names and bodies remain except the bounded patches below. The original raw snapshot is retained under ignored artifacts/ux/affectui-upstream/; canonical pinned links and original hashes allow re-acquisition without that local artifact.

## Shared declaration patch policy

Patches change declarations inside each source CSS string, in both light/dark blocks; they do not depend on global overrides defeating hoisted local variables. Root aliases exist before mount and on body-level portals. Styles exports take no props, return only the original href/precedence stylesheet and introduce no controller/effect/listener/timer/portal/trap. Class exports are immutable string records.

| Local visual role | Patched root role |
| --- | --- |
| surfaces/cards/menus/overlay | --panel |
| strong/ink/title/key | --ink |
| body/text/descriptions/neutral badge foreground | --aui-text (root --text) |
| actual secondary/icon | --muted |
| faint/placeholder/neutral dot | --faint |
| edge/strong edge | --line / --line-strong; checkbox edge keeps strong |
| interactive wash/hover | --hover |
| selected/pressed/switch-off | --select |
| neutral fill/tray/code/skeleton | --chip / --tray; skeleton sheen --hover |
| primary/on-solid/thumb | --primary / --primary-fg |
| primary hover | color-mix(primary 91%,transparent) |
| accent/info/cyan | --accent; info soft 12% mix |
| success/warning/danger/purple | trusted --aui semantic aliases; source-pinned light/dark semantics, not Pro observations |
| danger hover/soft | --aui-danger-soft |
| tooltip surface/ink/secondary | --primary / --primary-fg / 70% primary-fg mix |
| focus | --ui-as-focus |
| shadow edges/tint | --line or --line-strong; --aui-shadow-ink; original shadow lengths/layers retained |
| font/mono | --aui-font / --aui-font-mono root self-hosted/system stacks |
| radii | root 6/4/10px; Card 14px; Dialog 14px; sheet 0 |
| easing | cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) through --aui-ease |

Every adopted CSS root/visual alias suppresses animation and transition under either prefers-reduced-motion or root data-motion=reduce; static state translations/geometry remain. Button/IconButton pressed scale is suppressed. Loading shimmer/spinner does not keep moving; tool success check remains visible. Imperative Button and SegmentedControl cancellation is detailed below, since CSS alone cannot cancel those APIs.

## Per-file patch ledger and caller boundary

### avatar-clean.tsx

Only theme and CSS motion substitutions; retains original initials/anonymous/image-failure behavior. M4 supplies real Clerk person/name/image at 24px, no fabricated status/working/color/seed; AvatarGroup remains unused.

Changed original local declarations: `--ui-avtc-away`, `--ui-avtc-busy`, `--ui-avtc-edge`, `--ui-avtc-fill`, `--ui-avtc-ink`, `--ui-avtc-mark`, `--ui-avtc-online`, `--ui-avtc-ring`, `--ui-avtc-text`, `--ui-avtc-tile`. CSS aliases/additions are in this same file and use its original hoisted stylesheet.

### badge-clean.tsx

Adds BadgeStyles and six aui-badge variant classes: primary/on-primary default, chip/body secondary, danger-soft/danger destructive, transparent/strong edge outline, transparent/body ghost, transparent/accent hover-underline link. Alias controls share md 20px typography/geometry even on a Slot child. Label uses inline-flex with centered alignment, inherited gap and min-width:0 to preserve arbitrary SVG+text children under Tailwind preflight. Original tone/count/dot behavior preserved; production wrapper omits dot/live.

Changed original local declarations: `--ui-bdgc-danger-bg`, `--ui-bdgc-danger-fg`, `--ui-bdgc-info-bg`, `--ui-bdgc-info-fg`, `--ui-bdgc-neutral-bg`, `--ui-bdgc-neutral-dot`, `--ui-bdgc-neutral-fg`, `--ui-bdgc-purple-bg`, `--ui-bdgc-purple-fg`, `--ui-bdgc-success-bg`, `--ui-bdgc-success-fg`, `--ui-bdgc-warning-bg`, `--ui-bdgc-warning-fg`. ### button-clean.tsx

Adds ButtonStyles with the original ui-button-clean href; every source size/variant selector also accepts its aui-button class. Adds md and outline/link rules, square icon faces 28/24/24/32 and child SVG sizing. Native body and arbitrary children remain upstream. Label uses inline-flex with centered alignment, inherited gap and min-width:0 so arbitrary SVG+text children stay on one line under Tailwind preflight; its relative position, overflow and absolute animated pseudo-label remain intact. Internal and caller refs compose with React 19 callback cleanup and object reset. Width morph checks both OS and root reduction, stores/cancels Animation, observes root data-motion and media changes, disconnects/cancels on cleanup; permitted easing follows the theme curve. Wrapper owns submit versus explicit type and Slot semantics.

Changed original local declarations: `--ui-btnc-danger`, `--ui-btnc-danger-bg`, `--ui-btnc-danger-bg-hover`, `--ui-btnc-ease`, `--ui-btnc-focus`, `--ui-btnc-icon`, `--ui-btnc-ink`, `--ui-btnc-muted`, `--ui-btnc-on-solid`, `--ui-btnc-shadow`, `--ui-btnc-shadow-hover`, `--ui-btnc-shine`, `--ui-btnc-shine-on-solid`, `--ui-btnc-solid`, `--ui-btnc-solid-hover`, `--ui-btnc-surface`, `--ui-btnc-title`, `--ui-btnc-wash`. ### dropdown-menu-clean.tsx

Adds DropdownMenuStyles and immutable dropdownMenuClasses. Copies root tokens plus panel/title/item/separator/check visuals; excludes vendor fixed placement, margin, animation origin and manual glow controller. Radix highlighted/disabled/checked aliases own item appearance; label noninteractive and item has no nested control. Content alias uses overflow-y:auto and overflow-x:hidden with max-height=min(calc(100vh - 16px), var(--radix-dropdown-menu-content-available-height, calc(100vh - 16px))) so long portalled model lists scroll within both viewport and Radix available height; the original visible overflow is excluded from this alias. The wrapper data-slot selector repeats these containment declarations at greater specificity than caller classes, preserving the Radix height limit regardless of stylesheet order.

### message-actions-clean.tsx

Only theme and CSS motion substitutions at M1, including inverse local action tooltip. Upstream interaction exports preserved. Clipboard success/failure, disabled/request identity and exact answer/output integration are explicitly M6 patches; this source is not mounted at M1.

A1 patch (16 November 2026, [A1 packet](../../../../docs/ux/a1-admin-traces-feedback.md) decision 8): adds the optional prop `defaultVote?: FeedbackKind | null` (default `null`) with its doc comment, destructures it, and seeds the existing vote state with it (`useState<FeedbackKind | null>(defaultVote)`), so a saved rating shows pressed after a reload. Initial value only; the bar stays uncontrolled, a new version still resets the vote, and no handler body, CSS or export changes. Three hunks, +169 bytes (37,200 to 37,369), LF kept. Digest before `10b58462af731678e8d75c3a1059f1ac22b5a0b7894cce165957bcb255d654eb`, after `c023f70b281173593f5643e6b4916d4b3facfb8f4ed18ea4c2d75db712004658`. The double `down` callback (thumb, then reason) is not patched; the DATUMM caller serializes saves. Production `AnswerContent` mounts the feedback action only with a verified completion proof, a feedback handler and a reason list without "Other", so the upstream free-text input never renders.

## Qualification and retained limitations

M1 vendor-focused checks: all 22 TSX files transpile using the installed TypeScript compiler; all 22 CSS strings parse with the installed PostCSS parser. 103 direct in-memory assertions cover native input/textarea/select prop/ref/event/value/children identity, 9 Styles-only exports with original hoisted hrefs, Button app/OS reduction/cancel/cleanup and React 19 callback/object ref cleanup, and SegmentedControl actual reveal target/instant/smooth behavior plus app/OS preference-change cancellation and observer/listener/timer cleanup. These are focused source/API checks, not a browser, production build, full typecheck or proof of Radix focus/portal behavior. Shared-wrapper tests and real production-owner/browser qualification are performed by the M1 integrator; later caller mounts are M2/M4/M6/M7 per adapter contracts.

Upstream Checkbox still discards React 19 callback-ref cleanup; its agreed actual onboarding caller has no ref, and its body is intentionally unchanged under the bounded manifest. NumberInput/ProgressTracker are absent. Original custom Dialog/Select/Menu/Tooltip/Popover/Profile controllers are retained exports for provenance but must not be mounted around the existing Radix/native ownership. MessageActions and ToolCallCard were theme-only and unmounted at the M1 checkpoint; the M6 integration below now mounts their bounded semantic adapters. No claim of native approval, execution, verification, live tool timing or clipboard success is established by importing these files.

## M6 semantic patches and production adapters

ToolCallCard now defaults to recorded timing; its live stopwatch is isolated in a child mounted only for explicit live timing. Extended authoritative labels preserve pending/stopped/unknown states, details and custom argument/result labels. Only finite nonnegative recorded duration is rendered; zero remains 0ms. Every string payload is rendered/copied verbatim, including JSON-looking strings, duplicate keys, large integer text and whitespace; structured non-string values keep JSON formatting. Code regions remain bounded (220px/640px) and keyboard focusable. Existing source error auto-open remains caller-controlled; actual DATUMM callers must disable it and omit retry/start time.

MessageActions awaits its exclusive supplied copy callback (or actual clipboard), announces success only after resolution, reports failures, and disables action controls while requested. A render-time text/disabled generation plus unmount invalidation rejects obsolete clipboard completions and feedback timers. Production callers must explicitly select their actions (copy, plus feedback only as the A1 entry under [message-actions-clean.tsx](#message-actions-cleantsx) records) and bind keys/payload guards to the M3 scope epoch. Production `OutputPanel` mounts copy-only MessageActions; `AnswerContent` mounts copy, and adds feedback only on the proven saved answers the A1 entry describes, with exact answer/markdown text and streaming disablement. Scope epoch/source keys plus render-time text/request guards discard obsolete copy feedback; OutputPanel rethrows clipboard failures for truthful vendor announcements. Existing CSV remains independent. `RecordedTool` mounts ToolCallCard directly inside its list item, maps only explicit source aliases, retains raw identity/missing-record explanations and never supplies retry/start time. `OperationChangeSummary` mounts ChangeSummary with neutral counts in supplied-kind order; `ActivityPanel` mounts bare EmptyState for distinct no-task/unloaded-task states. The actual production owners and vendor code are exercised by focused M6 tests; browser focus/portal and live native qualification remain separate integrator gates. Unused MessageText/ToolCallGroup/regenerate/speech are not DATUMM features; feedback is one since A1, mounted only as that A1 entry records.
